title: Packed PCPP description
statement: Let a semantic reduction assign to each Boolean circuit on a positive number $n$ of input bits a PCPP description for the property that the circuit accepts. A packed PCPP description consists of a packed Boolean circuit and a PCPP description for its accepted-input property, with the description equal to the one assigned to that circuit by the semantic reduction.
hypotheses_covered: The source is a packed Boolean circuit with positive input length
The description is for the source circuit's accepted-input property
The description equals the semantic reduction's output on the source circuit
